name: Triple Lobber
description: a brimstone demon of the Cracked Road: a hunched body of cracked black basalt with molten orange light glowing through every seam, short curved horns of charred stone, small burning ember eyes, a wide jaw with a furnace glow inside, bigger, pale sandy-grey basalt, three long arms, a round glowing magma ball in each of the three hands

poses.stand: squatting on its haunches, three glowing magma balls held up in its three long arms
poses.struck: just hit and recoiling, eyes wide, mouth open, body jolted back, sparks and chips flying off it
poses.dead: breaking apart in a burst of black soot, grey ash and orange embers

idle.action: squats, juggling three glowing magma balls

attack.action: throws its three glowing magma balls forward and down to the right one after another

hurt.action: is struck, jerks backward with a pained grimace, then recovers

die.action: flares bright and breaks apart into soot, ash and embers
